_comment: P33-H5 (card t_94d361bb, CONCEPT_drohungsbudget Sec.2 Stufe 2): the Beschaffungs-Ranking vectors. Hand-pinned against the documented Core weight table (BudgetPlanner: axis 40/28/12, zone 30/21/9 by hops, urgency 5/loss when near(<=1), hunt buy +15, defend reinforce +15+2*size, leash +8, heavy = 5*cost>=3*threat, SparePenalty 400; the hold row participates in the sort at score 0, only Spar-penalised rows fall behind it). The record cross-check (harness --record) must reproduce every number byte-identically - a drift means the Core law changed, then re-read the playtest, never just re-record. Graph: S-A..S-D, door edges A-B,B-C,C-D,B-D => hops A-B 1, A-C 2, A-D 2, B-C 1, B-D 1, C-D 1.

cases.name: buy_beats_reinforce_hunt
cases._law: (a) jagd + Naehe: a purchase landing in the fight ring (zone dist 1 => 21 + hunt 15 = 36) beats a far reinforcement (dist 2 => 9, urgency needs near). Friendly [S-A] gives DG045 (S-C) no leash - honest 0.

cases.name: reinforce_beats_buy_defend
cases._law: (b) halten + Verlust in Kampfnaehe: the veteran group at the zone (dist 1 => 21 + 3 losses x5 = 15 + defend 15 + 2 x size 2 = 19 => 55) outranks a far purchase (dist 2 => 9). Posture adds NOTHING to a buy in defend - the posture axis itself flips the strict sequence's default.

cases.name: spare_defers_heavy_buy
cases._law: (c) Spar-Regel: DG045 is heavy (5x10=50 >= 3x12=36), would leave rest 2 BELOW the cheapest still-buyable card (3) and a BIGGER card (16) is reachable next round (16 <= 12+5) => -400 below the hold row; the light DG001 (not heavy) still runs. Player-33 deficit 2 'kein Horizont' fixed: threat must not rot into an unusable remainder.

cases.name: spare_off_in_dump
cases._law: (c2) Sparen NIE im Dumpfenster: identical case, dump=true - the Spar-Regel is inert, the heavy buy on the zone (30) leads. The FINAL-ROUND-DUMP law (threat may not survive the last round) stays the boss.

cases.name: spare_never_without_a_bigger_goal
cases._law: Sparing must AIM at something: threat 12, hand {10, 3}, NO bigger card (no candidate cost >10, no future cost) - the heavy buy is NOT spared (deferring the best card for nothing would just lose a round of pressure).

cases.name: spare_needs_light_leftover_below_next_stage
cases._law: The rest test of the concept literally ('Rest unter naechster-Kaufstufe'): threat 20, cards {14, 6} - heavy 14 (70 >= 60) leaves rest 6, which is NOT below the cheapest other (6), so the leftover still buys the next stage: no sparing.

cases.name: null_law_no_zones
cases._law: (d) Null-Law, machine-pinned in Core: no battle zone AND no axis zone => Rank answers NULL and the popup keeps today's strict sequence VERBATIM. 'Ohne Kampfzonen-Fakt = heutige Reihenfolge' needs no ordering computation - the head never speaks.

cases.name: tie_law_name_then_id_and_kind_first
cases._law: Tie chain: score, then KIND (reinforce before buy - the proven sequence - before hold), then name Ordinal, then id Ordinal. Alpha(DG060)/Bear(DG050) tie at 21: name wins over id (DG060 despite the bigger id). 'Same Name' pair ties at 9 and decides on kind: the reinforcement first, exactly the old strict default.

cases.name: player33_r3_axis_hunt
cases._law: Player-33 R3 evidence: Reinforcements popup, nobody wounded (no reinforcement candidate), the escape-axis section (H4b allyReaches) is the fight. Trandoshan's fresh DP reaches it (axis 1 => 28 + hunt 15 = 43) - the ranked buy now ALSO picks its DP toward the escape zone through the H4 ChooseScored law. No spare: no bigger card exists, so buying is right. DG001 gets the hunt bonus too (it covers ALL buys: 12 + 15 = 27).

cases.name: axis_primes_over_zone
cases._law: Controller order 07.11: the mission-axis zone is the HIGHER target weight. On-axis group: 40+21 = 61; zone-adjacent group: 12+21 = 33. The axis fact outranks the feed zone at equal measured distance classes.

cases.name: no_claim_never_far
cases._law: Loch-Gesetz (P33-H4 law rides): a section the observed graph does not connect contributes 0 - it is NEVER treated as 'far', but an honest far claim (2 hops => 9) still outscores no knowledge. Unknown must not beat a measured distance.

cases.name: leash_lands_near_own_groups
cases._law: Friendly-Sektionen (concept Stufe 1 'Kontaktlage'): a purchase whose fresh DP sits on a section holding own located groups gets the support bonus (+8): 21+8=29 - enough to beat a same-class claim without cover but NOT to outbuy the on-zone card (30).

cases.name: reader_junk_fails_closed
cases._law: Fail-closed reader law (fixture schema discipline): null rows, unknown kinds and empty ids are SKIPPED, never ranked; an unknown posture token claims nothing (no bonus); urgency needs near (losses far => no 5x).
